## Reviews

- [Control, tool use, and feedback](control-and-feedback.qmd) compares three ways an agent can change its behavior.
- [Evidence from agent benchmarks](agent-evaluation.qmd) examines how to interpret benchmark results and transfer them to a system design.

## Paper notes

- [ReAct](papers/yao2023react.qmd) explains reasoning, actions, and observations as parts of a single trajectory.
- [AgentBench](papers/liu2024agentbench.qmd) examines multi-environment evaluation and failure categories.

The [references](references.qmd) list the source records used throughout the course. The [primary book companions](../index.qmd#primary-book-companions) supply practical reading alongside these reviews and paper notes.
